project_type: Electron app with Lit web components, no build step, plain JS loaded via script tags
build_system: electron-forge (no transpilation, nodeIntegration: true, contextIsolation: false)
build_command: npm install (no build step needed, plain JS)
test_command: No test command available - manual validation only
verification_instructions: Run npx prettier --check . to verify code style. Ensure no syntax errors by checking imports/exports manually.
environment_constraints: No display/GUI available - cannot run electron app. Validation is AST/syntax-level. No Docker daemon.
contribution_requirements: Run prettier before committing. No linting. No automated tests yet.
key_patterns: Lit components import from ../../assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js. Views use unifiedPageStyles from sharedPageStyles.js. Sidebar items defined in renderSidebar() of CheatingDaddyApp.js. IPC is direct ipcRenderer/ipcMain (no context isolation). Renderer API exposed on window.cheatingDaddy object. Storage is file-based JSON (storage.js). Typing system in src/typing/ with BackendManager, TypingManager. Views are custom elements with static styles and properties.
directory_structure: src/components/app/ (main app shell), src/components/views/ (page views), src/utils/ (renderer.js, window.js, gemini.js), src/typing/ (typing system with backends/), src/assets/ (bundled libs), src/storage.js (file-based config)
